mapper.sql: b.id, b.building_no, b.name, b.unit_count, b.floor_count, b.house_count, b.building_type, b.build_year, b.total_area, b.manager, b.manager_phone, b.remark, b.create_time

, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house h WHERE h.building_id = b.id AND h.status IN ('OCCUPIED','RENTED')) AS occupied_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house h WHERE h.building_id = b.id AND h.status = 'EMPTY') AS empty_count, CONCAT(ROUND( IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house h WHERE h.building_id = b.id AND h.status IN ('OCCUPIED','RENTED')), 0) / GREATEST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house h WHERE h.building_id = b.id), 1) * 100, 1), '%') AS occupancy_rate
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO building (building_no, name, unit_count, floor_count, house_count, building_type, build_year, total_area, manager, manager_phone, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{buildingNo}, #{name}, #{unitCount}, #{floorCount}, #{houseCount}, #{buildingType}, #{buildYear}, #{totalArea}, #{manager}, #{managerPhone}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS buildingId, b.building_no AS buildingNo, COUNT(h.id) AS totalHouse, SUM(CASE WHEN h.status IN ('OCCUPIED','RENTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupiedHouse, SUM(CASE WHEN h.status = 'EMPTY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emptyHouse FROM building b LEFT JOIN house h ON h.building_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.building_no ORDER BY b.id
